posts.title: The ECO: The Right Solution to the Wrong Problem
posts.description: Should the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS) adopt a common currency? Most debates focus on whether a currency union will boost trade or erode monetary sovereignty. The key question is whether a regional central bank can resist fiscal dominance.

posts.title: Limits of Conventional Indicators in a Sea of Oil
posts.description: Fiscal policy, crowding out and overheating in resource-rich economies. Conventional macroeconomic statistics can conceal the magnitude of fiscal expansion in the non-oil economy.

posts.title: Buying Time for the Yen
posts.description: What a $59 billion intervention reveals about the foreign-exchange stock-flow constraint, and why even sizeable reserves can prove inadequate when the demand for foreign exchange remains persistent.
